acceptance_criteria.statement: Locked guide and append-only Evaluation lifecycle cover M4.1-M4.4.
Lookup proves authorization before provider access.
Proposal/approval preserves binding, immutability and human-only CAS decision.
Execution uses current authority and one idempotent external effect.
Reference provider/reconciliation covers crashes, restart, fencing and every closed outcome.
Audit reconstruction is complete and sanitized.
Exact-subject M1-M3/M4 verification and selective invalidation are recorded.
main remains unchanged and actual final review stays deferred.
Root-CWD Alembic failure is repaired without suppression.

design_decisions.decision: Guide has eleven observable cases matching the externally approved ticket contract, including explicit guide/Evaluation lifecycle authority.
All public expectations use independent literal matrices with status, recursive allowlists, durable effects and provider counters.
The guide separates tested_subject_sha from evidence-only and approval descendants and requires selective invalidation for all other change.
KNORA_DATABASE_URL, root CWD, pinned interpreter, sanitized effective database and Alembic head are mandatory evidence facets.
The worker produces only a final-review readiness template, never a fixed-point descriptor or code review.

invariants: Guide is unusable until independent review APPROVE and exact-digest delegated owner lock.
Every Evaluation is append-only; earlier guide/history bytes never change.
Denied paths reach no provider; one logical identity creates at most one external effect.
Known Alembic failure must become a root-CWD green regression without weakening.
Every final-suite non-pass node is individually inventoried; new skip/xfail is forbidden.
main remains unchanged and final code-review remains leader-only and deferred.
out_of_scope: Ticket-contract revision or guide semantics not reflected in the externally approved v2 packet.
Dynamic plugins, runtime provider registration, marketplace or vendor SDK integration.
Suppressing tests, fabricating evidence, accepting/integrating/merging/pushing/publishing or closing issues.
Creating, pinning, validating or invoking the actual final fixed-point descriptor/code-review.
